hooks.name: player_edit_book
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerEditBookEvent)

rust_summary: A player book edit or signing packet, cancellable (`native_player_edit_book`).
doc_summary: A server player book-and-quill packet is about to be applied. `pages` is its page count and `signing` says it has a title; set `cancel` to drop it. Helpers looking up the guest through `self.lan` may find nothing during packet handling. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_edit_book@.
